rows.description: Each row must contain exactly one scalar per column, in column order.

items.description: IDs must be unique within this form. Only select fields require options. Initial values must match the field kind; select initial values must be one of the options. Local preview, copy and reset only; no submission or host actions.

fallback.description: Readable plain-text equivalent for clients that cannot render this UI.

safeKey.description: A nonblank property name; prototype-related keys are forbidden.

expression.description: A bounded expression. Scalars are literal values. Objects explicitly name an operation. There is no script, function, HTML, CSS, network access, or implicit host authority. map/filter bind item in their second argument; event is available only in onChange. range(start,end,step=1) excludes end and yields at most 100 items. round(number,precision=0) accepts precision 0–8. format(number,style=number,currency?) supports number, percent, currency; currency requires an uppercase three-letter code. get(value,key) reads own object fields or nonnegative array indexes; missing fields return null. array constructs up to 16 values; object uses 2–16 alternating safe key/value arguments. sum accepts numeric arrays; map/filter bind item only in their second argument.

node_each.description: Optional key is an expression in the current item scope. Its result must be a nonblank string of at most 80 characters or a finite number within the normal numeric bounds; keys must be unique among siblings. Runtime validation enforces computed keys.

node_input.description: Date inputs bind an empty string or a valid Gregorian date in exact YYYY-MM-DD format, with years 0001–9999. Required fields are checked on explicit form submission.

fallback.description: Readable plain-text equivalent for clients that cannot render this UI.

specV2.description: Version 2: a safe, composable UI program. Declare state before body for streaming previews. Unique node IDs, at most 256 nodes and 12 nesting levels; expressions at most 16 levels and 2048 total; literal JSON at most 8 levels; initial state at most 16 KiB. onChange writes the bound state before actions. sendMessage requires an explicit button click or native form submission, retains the ordinary conversation approval path, and is unavailable during preview or another running turn. Forms use label as their native submit-button label and require onSubmit; nested forms are forbidden. Control required flags use native validity, and disabled/invalid are boolean expressions. Form submission may send one continuation just like an explicit button click.
